title: SEION scientific instance / execution / optimizer-restart record
description: Frozen v1 identity contract (mission section 2): every experiment record must distinguish scientific identity from mere re-execution from mere optimizer-restart, and must carry full provenance hashes.

scientific_instance_id.description: Identity of the *scientific question being asked* (example/config/arity/dimension/objective) — independent of how many times it has been executed or resumed.

execution_id.description: Identity of one specific run of a scientific_instance_id. Multiple execution_ids may share a scientific_instance_id (e.g. reruns for reproducibility); they are not independent scientific evidence of a different kind, only replication evidence.

optimizer_restart_id.description: Identity of a specific optimizer restart/checkpoint-resume within an execution. A new optimizer_restart_id from the same execution_id is NOT a new independent seed/trial (see evidence_contract.check_resumed_run_is_not_independent_seed).

code_commit.description: git commit SHA the execution ran at.

config_hash.description: sha256 of the fully resolved config.

model_state_hash.description: sha256 of the model/checkpoint state, if applicable.

checkpoint_lineage.description: Ordered list of checkpoint identifiers this execution/restart descends from, oldest first.

eval_mode.description: Screening-mode executions may never emit a certificate-tier status (evidence_contract.check_screening_cannot_emit_certificate).
